utility_assumptions: Fixed-anchor benefit utility is the reported recovery fraction or TREO grade fraction; linear preference is researcher-assumed, not JORC mandated.
Each panel defines a process boundary; named boundary variants, oxide sums and reported tests/models are treated as comparable only conditionally for screening.
Reported-case envelope is min/max of admitted source outcomes, including reported maxima as observed outcomes; never a population mean, measurement error bound or future performance prediction.
T-I has no adopted cross-reagent/functional-unit utility; full [0,1] remains for every group rather than zero fill, reweighting or merging abandoned routes.
T-P grade is only a concentration proxy, not a saleability/compliance score; missing full specifications remain in evidence crosswalk.
Independent criterion boxes are conservative outer sets; corners may combine incompatible cases and are never published as a realised design.
Project-transfer stress uses bound project-applicable evidence only; unproved extrapolation restores unknown utility without excluding any project.
Percentage-point perturbations and weights are explicit research stress assumptions, not source-derived confidence or probability distributions.

technical_profile.missing_rule: No match means UNKNOWN, never lower burden. N/A requires explicit source applicability, not absence.
technical_profile.negation_rule: Negated, hypothetical and forward-looking matches do not establish observed performance

numeric_model.anchors: Physical fractions 0..1 are preference assumptions, not engineering pass thresholds; infrastructure keeps existing 0..2000 km anchor

model_assumptions: Each source dated mine-plan design forecast, not operating performance
Compare whole-feed oxide recovery and concentrate oxide grade; no extrapolation to all deposits or to separated oxides
Different mineral assemblages are background mechanisms, not numerical bonuses
Only one explicitly typed engineering design case per project; competing cases excluded rather than selecting maximum or newest

TPR.quantity: TREO mass recovered in mineral concentrate / TREO in whole ore

numeric_model.dependency_audit: Grade and recovery have distinct numerators/denominators; no enrichment, contained resource or product tonnage included. Same-source errors dependent and unquantified; no independent measurement noise drawn. Study maturity not scored. Both cases have equal existing D1=0.6; it contributes no discrimination. Do not interpret D1 weighting as independent validation quality. GIS comparison excluded where Yangibana has no selected representative point; no zero imputation.
numeric_model.reference_scope: Existing development study maturity score, fixed at source DFS design in both named cases; invariant context not Technical performance or evidence-quality bonus
numeric_model.uncertainty: NO_SOURCE_MEASUREMENT_BOUNDS; deterministic scope scenarios; existing seeded weight Monte Carlo only, not success probability
